description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 013 make a jali wall for climbing plants: the product photo shows a semicircle, arch-scallop terracotta jali with a creeper growing through it, suited to garden walls, patios and courtyards where you want greenery on a solid clay frame.

## How it looks
Rows of half-circle openings stack into an arch pattern, so the wall has a soft, curving rhythm instead of straight lines. In the photo a climbing creeper threads through the openings, and the warm terracotta shows between the leaves. The effect is closer to a living screen than a plain boundary.

## Where it works
- **Terracotta trellis wall** for jasmine, money plant or other climbers along a garden edge.
- **Arch jali for garden** walls around a lawn, a pathway or an outdoor seating corner.
- **Semicircle jali design** as a courtyard feature that softens a plain plastered wall.

Fired clay is generally a durable choice outdoors in Pakistan's sun and rain, and the openings give climbers something to hold while air still moves through the wall.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Design: semicircle / arch-scallop openings, shown with a climbing creeper (from the product photo)
- Material colour, block size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you order.

Plant climbers at the base rather than in the openings, and trim them yearly so roots and stems do not crowd the joints. Clean exposed clay with a soft brush and water; avoid acid cleaners.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm, or ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall size for a dated quote. Compare it with the [scallop pattern jali](/products/terracotta-jali-tiles-008), read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of a jali wall for climbing plants?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Will climbing plants damage a terracotta jali wall?
faqs.a: Climbers usually sit well on clay jali if they are planted at the base and trimmed each year. Keep thick stems and roots out of the mortar joints.

faqs.q: Terracotta jali or a metal trellis for climbers?
faqs.a: A metal trellis is lighter and cheaper to fix to an existing wall; a terracotta jali wall is a permanent structure that works as a boundary and a trellis at once, and does not rust.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 013" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
